text:
Mira: quick sync — we need to lock lanes for the Q3 pragmatic-lanes initiative. Customers want private deploy + low latency. We have runtime, infra, security deps. Immediate blockers?
Alex: runtime: main blocker is validating 4-bit quant kernels across our model family. Plan: kernel bench + small e2e. Est 2w.
Sofia: infra: hosted capacity ok. Dedicated/reserved pools need slot reservations, VPC egress rules. Staging HSM endpoint + certing is a separate 3w path. Need tickets.
Dan: security: HSM/KMS integration needs design review + compliance checklist. Can we do a canary that doesn’t require customer HSM to speed canary?
Mira: yes—product ok with canary without enforced HSM for low-risk customers. Need rollback and opt-in flag for HSM.
Kevin: platform will own the flag. I’ll add feature flag require_hsm with canary rollout. Need acceptance criteria and a fallback to a software KMS if HSM calls fail.
Luis: acceptance criteria: P50 <120ms single-turn chat for canary tenants, no regressions on hallucination evals, and toggle of require_hsm in staging. Docs + onboarding checklist for HSM customers.
Alex: suggested timeline: week1 kernel bench + infra perf tests; week2 e2e with KV cache and prewarm; week3 canary. If infra reserves slots earlier we can parallelize.
Sofia: I can carve slot reservations in parallel but need exact GPU type and expected QPS to size. Lock GPU today?
Mira: target GA3/16GB for Dedicated pilot. Expected QPS ~25/sec initial tenant mix.
Dan: to speed security review, share a minimal compliance checklist for canary. Full SOC docs for GA.
Kevin: sample config: feature_flags.require_hsm=false for canary, fallback_policy.on_hsm_error=use_software_kms.
Mira: add SLA/rollback playbook stub: steps if latency >2x baseline or error rate >1%.
Alex: runtime rollback plan: quick pin to fp16 variant if quant profile degrades quality. Can routing support per-tenant variant pins?
Kevin: yes, routing supports per-tenant pins. I’ll add rule to prefer fp16 when quality regression crosses threshold.
Sofia: infra follow-ups: I’ll open tickets for reserved slots, VPC egress, staging HSM endpoint. Need owners.
Mira: owners: Alex=runtime validation, Sofia=infra tickets, Dan=security checklist, Kevin=feature flag + routing, Luis=acceptance criteria + docs. I’ll sync with sales for canary customers.
deploy-bot: Ticket created PLAT-789 "feature flag: require_hsm" assigned to Kevin.
Luis: will draft onboarding + acceptance tests and attach to PLAT-789 today.
Mira: ok team—next check-in in 48h. Ping this thread and tag @Mira for blockers. :thumbsup:
